description: Source code for a stub audio decoder implementation in the starboard media framework, including methods for decoding audio buffers, handling end-of-stream, and creating decoded audio data.

classes.name: StubAudioDecoder
classes.description: A stub implementation of an audio decoder that generates synthetic audio data for testing or placeholder purposes.

methods.name: GetSupportedSampleType
methods.description: Determines the supported audio sample type, preferring float32 if supported, otherwise int16.

methods.name: CalculateFramesPerInputBuffer
methods.description: Calculates the number of audio frames per input buffer based on timestamps.

methods.name: CreateDecodedAudio
methods.description: Creates a DecodedAudio object filled with synthetic data based on sample type.
